stem: How did the Great Depression affect American society?

options.label: A
options.text: The price of agricultural goods decreased, causing an increase in demand for farm labor.

options.label: B
options.text: Manufacturing wages increased, causing businesses to concede to labor union demands.

options.label: C
options.text: Demand for luxury goods increased, causing overproduction in manufacturing.

options.label: D
options.text: Businesses were forced to close, causing widespread unemployment.
